visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short black hair and a beige scarf is seen smelling a small cosmetic cup indoors. She is wearing a brown wool coat. (2) Chronological montage of a morning routine: she brushes her teeth in a white hoodie, eats a croissant, and applies a hair roller to her bangs. Yellow captions indicate the time. (3) The woman demonstrates a Shu Uemura foundation bottle. She applies dots of the liquid to her cheeks and forehead, then blends it with a sponge in a brightly lit indoor room. (4) A split-screen comparison labeled 'Before' and 'After' shows her skin texture. She is now dressed in a brown coat and beret, showing off her makeup in natural daylight. (5) Fast-paced cuts show her visiting a media event and talking to a man in a suit, getting her hair trimmed at a salon, walking through rainy streets with an umbrella, browsing items in a gift shop, and eating a bowl of ramen. (6) The woman returns home in the evening, wearing a brown sweater vest. She points to her face, showing the makeup's longevity. Text overlays with promotional offers and brand logos appear.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a day in the life of a vlogger in Tokyo to demonstrate and promote the high durability and long-lasting quality of Shu Uemura foundation through a real-world stress test.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct product demonstration, verbal recommendation, and explicit on-screen call-to-action with promotional offers.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-quality lifestyle production blending personal vlogging with professional beauty endorsement; effectively uses temporal markers to validate product claims.
